title: RNA Extraction for RIN and DV 200 Analysis
author: Jamie Allen
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.86nhzde
materials: Move supernatant to a new 1.5 mL tube.
Discard supernatant and add 600 μL 80% Ethanol.

steps.title: Sample Homogenization
steps.instruction: Place tissue section in 750 μL of TRIzoILS and homogenize the sample.

substeps.instruction: Use a homogenizer or pass sample through a 23G then a 27G needle syringe.

steps.title: Sample Preparation and Mixing
steps.instruction: Prepare the sample by freeze-thawing and adjusting volume.

substeps.instruction: Freeze samples on dry ice and re-thaw once.
Mix well by vortexing.
Add RNase free water to a final volume of 960 μL.
Add 40 μL of glycogen solution (5mg/mL, making a final conc of 200 μg/mL of glycogen) to each tube and mix well.

steps.title: Phase Lock Gel Preparation
steps.instruction: Prepare the Phase Lock Gel column and load the sample.

substeps.instruction: Centrifuge Phase Lock Gel at 12,000 x g for 5 minutes to move gel to the bottom of the column.
Transfer the TRIzol mixture to the column.
Incubate for 5 minutes at 20 °C (room temperature).
Add 250 μL of chloroform and shake for 15 seconds.
Centrifuge at 12,000 x g for 10 minutes at 4 °C.
Add 600 μL isopropanol.
Vortex and incubate the tube at -20 °C for 20 minutes.
Centrifuge at 20,000 x g for 20 minutes at 4 °C.

steps.title: RNA Solubilization
steps.instruction: Resuspend the RNA pellet using RLT plus buffer.

substeps.instruction: Add 300 μL of RLT plus buffer (from Qiagen RNeasy Plus Micro Kit) containing 2-ME (10 μL of 2-ME for 1 mL of RLT Plus Buffer, 1% 2-ME) and mix.
Vortex and centrifuge at 20,000 x g for 5 minutes at 4 °C.

steps.title: Sample Cleaning and Ethanol Addition
steps.instruction: Clean the pellet and prepare for column loading.

substeps.instruction: Discard supernatant and air dry for a few minutes.
Add 450 μL 100% ethanol (1.5 volumes) and mix well.

steps.title: RNeasy Column Loading
steps.instruction: Load the sample onto the RNeasy MinElute spin column using a double application.

substeps.instruction: Transfer 750 μL of the sample to RNeasy MinElute spin column and centrifuge for 1 min at 12,000 x g at 24 °C.
Transfer the collected flow through back through the same column and centrifuge for 1 min at 12,000 x g at 24 °C.
Discard the flow through after the second centrifugation.

steps.title: Column Washing
steps.instruction: Wash the column membrane using RPE buffer.

substeps.instruction: Add 500 μL of RPE buffer to the column and centrifuge at 12,000 x g for 1 min at 24 °C.
Discard flow through and add 500 μL RPE buffer to the column.
Centrifuge at 12,000 x g for 2 min at 24 °C.
Transfer column to a new collection tube and discard the old collection tube with the flow through.
Open the lid of the column and centrifuge at 12,000 x g for 5 min at 24 °C.

steps.title: RNA Elution
steps.instruction: Perform a double elution of the RNA.

substeps.instruction: Place the column in a new 1.5 mL tube and add 10 μL of RNase free water on the center of the column membrane.
Incubate for 2 min at 20 °C.
Centrifuge at 12,000 x g for 3 min at 24 °C.
Add 10 μL of RNase free water again on the center of the column membrane and incubate for 2 min at 20 °C.
Centrifuge at 12,000 x g for 3 min at 24 °C.

steps.title: Final Sample Submission
steps.instruction: Provide VANTAGE Core with 10 μL of solution for RIN and DV 200 analysis.
